update.title:
/bin/sh -c "python3 -c \"
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/home/agent/workspace/migration/test.db')
with open('/home/agent/workspace/migration/verify.sql') as f:
    verify = f.read()
try:
    conn.executescript(verify)
    cursor = conn.execute('SELECT * FROM orders')
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    print('Columns:', [d[0] for d in cursor.description])
    for row in rows:
        print(row)
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
conn.close()
\""
